kurals.tr: Katanenpa Nallavai Ellaam Katanarindhu / Saandraanmai Merkol Pavarkku
kurals.m: It is said that those who are conscious of their duty and behave with a perfect goodness will regard as natural all that is good

kurals.tr: Kunanalam Saandror Nalane Piranalam / Ennalaththu Ulladhooum Andru
kurals.m: The only delight of the perfect is that of their goodness; all other (sensual) delights are not to be included among any (true) delights

kurals.tr: Anpunaan Oppuravu Kannottam Vaaimaiyotu / Aindhusaal Oondriya Thoon
kurals.m: Affection, fear (of sin), benevolence, favour and truthfulness; these are the five pillars on which perfect goodness rests

kurals.tr: Kollaa Nalaththadhu Nonmai Pirardheemai / Sollaa Nalaththadhu Saalpu
kurals.m: Penance consists in the goodness that kills not , and perfection in the goodness that tells not others' faults

kurals.tr: Aatruvaar Aatral Panidhal Adhusaandror / Maatraarai Maatrum Patai
kurals.m: Stooping (to inferiors) is the strength of those who can accomplish (an undertaking); and that is the weapon with which the great avert their foes

kurals.tr: Saalpirkuk Kattalai Yaadhenin Tholvi / Thulaiyallaar Kannum Kolal
kurals.m: The touch-stone of perfection is to receive a defeat even at the hands of one's inferiors

kurals.tr: Innaasey Thaarkkum Iniyave Seyyaakkaal / Enna Payaththadho Saalpu
kurals.m: Of what avail is perfect goodness if it cannot do pleasing things even to those who have pained (it) ?

kurals.tr: Inmai Oruvarku Ilivandru Saalpennum / Thinmai Un Taakap Perin
kurals.m: Poverty is no disgrace to one who abounds in good qualities

kurals.tr: Oozhi Peyarinum Thaampeyaraar Saandraanmaikku / Aazhi Enappatu Vaar
kurals.m: Those who are said to be the shore of the sea of perfection will never change, though ages may change

kurals.tr: Saandravar Saandraanmai Kundrin Irunilandhaan / Thaangaadhu Manno Porai
kurals.m: If there is a defect in the character of the perfect, (even) the great world cannot bear (its) burden
